request: Can the two-finger ring become an arch over the bridge?
name: King’s Chapel Bridge Arch
status: Design concept for review; not implemented in the game
visualReview: Paired rounded silver arch frames span the bridge entrance. Fan ribs meet side abutments; the green faceted prism sits overhead. The deck remains visually clear for pedestrians. LIVISTONE lettering is legible. The output interprets the overhead prism as a broad crown rather than the precise longitudinal ridge described in the prompt.
